newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Friday, dealers said.
Analysts had anticipated that the Fed would stay out of the open market.
The Fed added $1.752 billion in temporary reserves to the banking system through four-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday.
Federal funds were trading at 5-3/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate, at the Fed's typical time for operations.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
